issues.reason: The invented-scale half stands — the text's word is "rose", and Measures & units says the scale is the surface dimension ("Record what's said"), with the doctrine against single-word synonyms reinforcing it, so the scale must be rise, not the unsaid increase — while "Measure states a value, not an increment" is the reviewer's own first gap, where improvisation with a true, well-typed atom is licensed.

A Measure's magnitude is defined as "a native number", and the instruction set itself reads number words straight into natives (half → 0.5 in TimesAs, "a couple" → 2, "a dozen" → 12); Fraction lives only in ProportionOf's level slot, which the reviewer's own fourth gap concedes, so 0.1 is a reading, not forbidden arithmetic.

The slot mis-fill stands — Comparatives & degree fixes (Most <scale> X <class>) with the scale the lemmatized adjective (high) and the class the superlative's noun (level), so the noun "level" in the scale slot reads falsely — but "the thing ranked must be the 6.1% figure" is overstated: the bare value has no symbol and the appositive predicates of the rate's new level, so sk_rate_1 stays.

No head carries a superlative's comparison window (the reviewer's own third gap), and the instruction set's standing direction for an adverbial with no licensed carrier is to "leave the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slot it" — a TimeAtLeast on the rise would assert a bound on the rise's own time that the text does not state.

gaps_confirmed: A measured increment of a quantity over time ("rose a tenth of a percentage point"): Measure states a value and MoreBy a two-entity gap; no form covers a delta predicated of a change event.
The resulting value of a change ("rose … to 6.1%"): motion-result Goal is for paths, and a Measure on the entity loses the link to the event.
A superlative restricted to a time window ("the highest level since July 1994"): Most has only <scale> <entity> <class> and no window slot.
new_gaps: A superlative whose comparison class is the entity's own values over time ("the highest level") cannot be distinguished from one over other members of the class — Most's third slot carries only a class symbol.
repair_summary: Renamed the improvised Measure scale from the unsaid synonym increase to the surface word rise; rewrote the superlative as (Most high sk_rate_1 level) so the scale is the lemmatized adjective and the class is the superlative's noun.
notes: The reviewer's fourth gap (Fraction for a quantity of a unit) is not a gap — the magnitude slot takes a native number and 0.1 is exact. "since July 1994" stays out because every carrier for it would assert something the text does not state.
